# SaifCodes (saifcodes.com) — LLM-Friendly Overview

> Muhammad Saif is a full-stack developer and AI engineer in Lahore, Pakistan. For 8+ years, he has been building AI products, full-stack SaaS and the servers they run on for clients around the world.

**Owner**: Muhammad Saif (SaifCodes)\
**Role**: Full-Stack Developer & AI Engineer\
**Primary website**: https://saifcodes.com/\
**Primary language**: English (en-US)\
**Location**: Lahore, Pakistan

## 1) Summary (for quick Q&A)
Hi, I'm Saif. AI engineer & full-stack developer. I build AI products & SaaS that actually ship from the first prototype to the server it runs on.

Chatbots that know your data, automations that save your team hours, and SaaS platforms built to grow. I handle the whole thing: backend, frontend, AI and deployment, so you only need one person.

Current site stats:

- **8+** years building software.
- **67+** projects delivered on Upwork.
- **20+** AI models in production.

Projects can include a first MVP, an AI feature for an existing product or a system that needs to scale. Most projects start with a quick chat.

## 2) What I Work With
Most projects need more than one skill set. I bring AI, web development and infrastructure together, so nothing gets lost between teams.

- **Artificial Intelligence & ML**: Generative AI & LLMs, AI model training, small language models, Segment Anything (SAM), chatbot development, enterprise RAG systems, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, NLP, image recognition, predictive analytics, diffusion models, vision transformers and reinforcement learning.
- **Web & Software Development**: Python, TypeScript, PHP, C/C++, Vue.js, React, Next.js, FastAPI, Django, Laravel, Node.js, RESTful APIs, JWT/SAML SSO, OAuth, OpenID Connect, zero-knowledge auth, end-to-end encrypted apps, AI SaaS, ERP & CRM development, web & browser automation, web scraping and data pipelines.
- **Cloud & Server Management**: AWS, Azure, GCP, Digital Ocean, Linux & Windows server administration, server security maintenance, web hosting & database migrations, PowerMTA, Postal Server and DevOps pipelines.
- **Databases**: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MSSQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, database architecture, data visualization and data migration.

## 3) Background & Experience
- **Freelance Full-Stack Developer & AI Engineer — Upwork (Top Rated), 2019–Present**: 67+ projects for clients around the world, including subscription APIs, cloud computer vision systems and AI automations.
- **IT Manager — Unitech Auto Industries Pvt Ltd, Nov 2018–Present**: Networks, servers, security and everyday IT systems at a manufacturing company.
- **AI Developer — Various Projects, 5+ years**: Designing, training and deploying machine learning and deep learning models, from computer vision to language models, in real products.
- **Education**: BS Software Engineering, Virtual University Of Pakistan (2020); F.Sc Pre-Engineering, Govt Degree College Mian Channu.

## 6) Portfolio Index (case studies)
Each project has a canonical case-study page at: `https://saifcodes.com/projects/<slug>`

- [AI-Powered News Automation](https://saifcodes.com/projects/ai-powered-news-automation)\
  Category: SaaS/AI • Tech: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, OpenAI, WordPress\
  Summary: A Spanish news site that mostly runs itself: it gathers stories, writes articles with AI, creates thumbnails and publishes to WordPress.\
  Live demo: https://elpuebloinforma.com/

- [Facial Verification & KYC System](https://saifcodes.com/projects/facial-verification)\
  Category: AI/CV • Tech: Python, OpenCV, Flask, MySQL\
  Summary: Identity checks without the paperwork. A live selfie is matched against an ID document, and users get their result right away. Supports CNIC, passport or other ID uploads.

- [Automated Web Form Filling System](https://saifcodes.com/projects/form-filling)\
  Category: Automation • Tech: Node.js, Puppeteer, Residential Proxy, PHP, JavaScript\
  Summary: Browser automation that fills forms at scale, with human-like browsing, smart proxies and a dashboard anyone can run. Includes reusable field mapping, bulk CSV uploads, location-aware residential proxies and automatic captcha handling.\
  Live demo: https://webautoma.com/

- [Project Chat AI](https://saifcodes.com/projects/project-chat-ai)\
  Category: SaaS/AI • Tech: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, OpenAI, Django, React, Next.js, PyTorch, Transformers, vLLM\
  Summary: An AI assistant that knows your project. It answers questions from your own documents and connected drives. Features separate workspaces, Google Drive and Dropbox sync, enterprise RAG, side-by-side model comparison, parallel image generation and an admin dashboard.\
  Live demo: https://projectchat.ai/

- [Swimming Tracking & Analytics](https://saifcodes.com/projects/swiming-tracking)\
  Category: AI/CV • Tech: Python, OpenCV, Cloud, PHP, JavaScript\
  Summary: Computer vision for the pool. It tracks every swimmer, spots who finishes first and times each one. Works with uploaded race footage and live camera feeds, with a dashboard to review results.

- [AI-Driven Twitter Automation](https://saifcodes.com/projects/twitter-automation)\
  Category: SaaS/AI • Tech: Python, GPT-4, Tweepy, Django, React\
  Summary: A Twitter/X account that almost runs itself: posting, rewriting, replies and growth, without sounding like a bot. Includes scheduled posting, rewriting trending content in the account's voice, replies to mentions and DMs, and automated audience engagement.

## 7) Writing / Blog (technical notes)
Blog posts live at: `https://saifcodes.com/blog/<slug>`

- [Optimizing Large Language Models for Production](https://saifcodes.com/blog/optimizing-llms)\
  Category: AI Research • Published: 2024-10-15 • Reading time: 5 min\
  Summary: How to reduce latency and cost when deploying LLMs using quantization and efficient inference servers. Discusses FP16/INT8, vLLM, TGI, TensorRT-LLM, continuous batching and PagedAttention.
